agent_notes.else: Completed competitor analysis (2026-04-06). Analyzed 6 competitors: Notion, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote, Apple Notes, Roam Research. Key finding: the $3-8/mo cross-platform tier is underserved. Identified 5 market gaps including onboarding vs. power, collaboration + privacy, and meaningful AI integration. Pricing recommendation summary passed to nora: freemium with ~$6-8/mo individual and ~$8-10/user/mo team tier. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-competitor-analysis.md
agent_notes.nora: Completed pricing recommendation (2026-04-06). Designed three-tier freemium model: Free (2 devices, 1 GB, no AI), Pro at $7/mo ($70/yr), Team at $9/user/mo ($90/user/yr). AI included in Pro (not a separate add-on) as key differentiator against Notion. Revenue model projects ~$84K ARR at 1,000 paying customers. Recommended freemium over paid-only. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-pricing-recommendation.md
agent_notes.dag: Completed infrastructure and CI/CD (2026-04-06). Dockerfile (python:3.12-slim, non-root user, stdlib healthcheck, uvicorn main:app entrypoint), docker-compose.yml (joke-api:local), .env.example, .dockerignore, and a three-job GitHub Actions workflow (test -> build-and-push to ghcr.io -> railway up --service joke-api with post-deploy health check). Zero-downtime via Railway rolling deploy + HEALTHCHECK directive. All assumptions validated against bjorn's joke REST API architecture. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-infrastructure-and-cicd.md
agent_notes.bjorn: Completed system architecture (2026-04-06). FastAPI + Python on Railway. Jokes in bundled jokes.json (no DB). 3 endpoints: GET /joke (random), GET /joke/{id} (lookup), GET /jokes (full list, optional ?category filter). In-process dict index built at startup for O(1) ID lookup. 4 ADRs: static file over DB, random.choice over deterministic, in-process dict index, no pagination. Component file map for Arve: main.py, routers/joke.py, services/joke_service.py, data/jokes.json, tests/test_joke.py. Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-system-architecture.md
agent_notes.arve: Completed implementation (2026-04-06). FastAPI app in src/ with root-level main.py (matches dag's uvicorn main:app entrypoint). Implemented all 3 endpoints + /health. 30 jokes across 4 categories (general, programming, science, food) in data/jokes.json. Service layer uses O(1) dict index for ID lookup, random.choice for selection, case-insensitive category filter. 24 tests pass (13 unit, 11 integration). Output: projects/test-autodispatch/output/2026-04-06-implementation.md
